summary: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. (ATII) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Forge Nano, Inc. ATII will reincorporate as a Delaware corporation via merger with wholly-owned subsidiary Pubco, which will survive as Forge Nano Holdings Inc. Each ATII unit will separate into one ordinary share and one-half warrant, with each share exchanging for one Pubco common share and each warrant converting into Pubco warrants. No purchase price, premium, advisor, or break fee are stated. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and shareholder approval, including potential redemptions. Watch for shareholder vote timing and redemption risk.
